title: NutrientEarthResearchRecord
description: Standardized schema for peer-reviewed research papers, clinical trials, and scientific studies across all sources.

record_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the record in Nutrient Earth (e.g., res_ayush_238139 or res_doi_10.1016...).

source_id.description: Identifier of the source organization or portal (e.g., src_ayushportal, src_zenodo, src_osf).

original_source_id.description: Internal ID from the original portal or database (e.g. ARP ID, Zenodo record ID).

title.description: Full normalized title of the publication or trial.

publication_date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD) or publication year.

journal.description: Journal, periodical, or publishing venue name.

url.description: Original persistent URL or landing page.

pdf_url.description: Direct download link to open-access PDF if legally accessible.

local_pdf_path.description: Relative path to saved PDF within research_data/documents/pdf/ if downloaded.

population.description: Target subject population details (e.g. Healthy adults, Type 2 diabetes patients).

intervention.description: Specific botanical formulation, nutrient, dosage, or therapeutic procedure tested.

comparator.description: Control substance, placebo, or standard care comparison.

outcomes.description: Primary and secondary endpoints measured (e.g. HbA1c, lipid profile, fasting glucose).

results_summary.description: Objective summary of statistical findings, effect sizes, and p-values.

limitations.description: Documented limitations (e.g. small sample size, open-label design, duration).

funding_and_conflicts.description: Reported funding organizations and conflict of interest disclosures.

relevance_score.description: Nutrient Earth relevance metric based on nutrition, botanical, and metabolic relevance.

license.description: Copyright, CC license, or open access license governing the paper.
